correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs every factorization regime. Prime powers have exact value \(1+p+\cdots+p^{a-2}\). For fixed support, \(z(n)/n\) increases strictly with each exponent and composite \(z(n)\) is positive. Thus nonsquarefree two-prime support is minimized by one squared prime; the exact formulas \(q+2p+1\) and \(p+2q+1\) give the unique boundary \(12\). Three-prime squarefree support has exact value \(2(p+q+r)\ge20\), and added support or exponents increase the gap.
